newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list Innovex options on Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list Innovex options on Jan 2.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Tuesday it will list options on Innovex Inc on January 2.
The options will have opening strike prices of 25, 30 and 35, with introductory expirations in January, February, May and August.
Shares of the thin film lead wire maker were down 1-1/4 at 27-1/2 Tuesday around midday.
The CBOE said O.T.A. LP will be the designated primary market maker (DPM). ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
